As you pry it open, your arm is

spans.t: Barnacle Crusted Chest
A treasure chest blanketed in barnacles. You
open it rather easily and a noxious permeating
odour from the rotting barnacles invades
your nostrils. Cursing your luck you grab
a satchel filled with coins and provisions
resting on the bottom of the chest.
3t

spans.t: Bas Relief
A puzzingly ancient sculpture of dizzying
implication...Noticing the gold thrown in
front of it... are these... offerings? You
grab them quickly, praying that nothing
malignant is watching you do this.

spans.t: Bas Relief
A puzzingly ancient sculpture of dizzying
implication...You touch its rough surface as
a piece of sharp stone detaches and cuts you
heavily on the wrist. Your hand goes numb
and you start to lose blood, the wound looks
contaminated and needs to be treated quickly!

spans.t: Brackish Tide Pool
A pool of water cupped in smooth stone.
Its color looks slightly off... A rotting
odour emanates from it, making your
lungs protest in pain. You step back
and try to exhale out the air. You feel
weak, yet even more resolute.
2t

spans.t: Eerie Coral
There is something odd about this
coral. Touching its surface you notice
its colors brightening and then with a
small snap, your finger gets mangled
in its odd-looking hidden jaw.
2t

spans.t: Eerie Coral
There is something odd about this coral.
Yet you feel drawn to it, but when you
get close it lets out a big puff of noxious
smoke. Your knees are weak, your throat
goes dry and you start to cough up blood.
2t

spans.t: Fish Idol
A strange presence is felt near this statue
of worship. You fall to your knees to pick
up the coin offerings, and you immediately
get the feeling that you’re being watched.
Looking back at the idol, you shake that creepy
thought away and you rise to your feet.
2t

spans.t: Fish Idol
A strange presence is felt near this statue of
worship. Convinced that it might have some sort
of secret mechanism, you twist its head. Moldy
and rotten, it gives way, as part of its residue is
smeared onto your face. You clean your face from
a nearby puddle, alas filled with noxious water.
2t

spans.t: Fish Carcass
A stuffed sea creature has washed ashore.
Wonder what it ate?... Glistening where its
stomach should’ve been, you see a slimy satchel
with some provisions. As you pull it out, your
gloved hand finds its razor sharp bones. You
feel a shiver down your spine, as the carcass’
contaminating toxins invade your body.
3t

spans.t: Giant Oyster
A live oyster. Who knows what value it
hides... Eager and greedy you pry it open,
only to discover a trinket with some gold.
Your spirits are lifted but in an instant the
oyster clams shut, cutting your arm almost
in half. As the blood flows into its mouth, it
opens now on its own, eager... and greedy.
3t

spans.t: Ship’s Figurehead
The figurehead emits a marvelous aura.
Unnerved yet inspired, you reach for the
satchel hanging from it. There are still some
provisions left in it! As you stash them away,
you feel its aura intensifying, manifesting in
a curse that’ll haunt you soon enough...
2t

coins and a trinket... and a hidden
coral crab! It breaks your fingers
with a snap, eager for some blood!
